name: crash_regression_bug
title: Fix Crash on PDF Export with Large Documents
description: Users report a crash when exporting documents larger than 50MB to PDF. The crash occurs in the rendering pipeline during page composition. Stack trace points to memory pressure in the image scaling subsystem. Regression introduced in v2.3.1 after the image optimization refactor.

requirements.description: Identify root cause of crash in PDF rendering pipeline for documents over 50MB
Fix memory allocation pattern in image scaling to use streaming instead of full-buffer
Add regression test with 100MB test document
Peak memory usage during export must not exceed 256MB regardless of document size
Export time for 50MB document must remain under 30 seconds
Add memory pressure monitoring with graceful degradation

constraints: Must not break existing PDF export for documents under 50MB
No new third-party dependencies for image processing
Fix must be backward-compatible with existing saved documents
